title: Large Industrial Heavy-Duty Motors, 1960s Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century snapshot capturing two large vertical electric motors or heavy-duty pump drives resting on wooden pallets in an industrial staging area. The massive cylindrical equipment features conical head caps, side-mounted electrical junction boxes, and rectangular cooling vent slots along the base. The reverse of the photo is stamped with the identification number 3040.
